style_snapshot.name: Ludo Club - Deeper
style_snapshot.generation_hints: Front-facing 3/4 perspective with slight top-down tilt, stylized mobile-game digital painting style, deep navy-to-purple gradient backgrounds with festive crowd bokeh and stage lighting, vibrant palette strictly using deep indigo #1a0a3e, amber #f5a623, coral-red #e8432a, emerald #2ecc71, violet #8b5cf6, hot pink #ff6fb5, sky blue #1e90ff, and gold #ffd700, glossy highlights and soft painted gradients defining form without hard outlines, Brazilian carnival energy with celebratory confetti, vibrant feathers and tropical joy, mixed-scale compositions including hero banners with grouped characters, medium close-up 3D dice assets, and small collectible icon tiles, thin decorative borders on UI elements, warm ambient glow for object showcases, character styling and in-game assets must remain consistent with established visual theme throughout.

style_note: Line 1 should be bright and with a nice heavy shadow. Line 2 to have a bright outline, with a darker coloured font.
